brief:
Mahmoud Khalil returned to Columbia University to discuss his memoir, which documents his arrest and detention by US immigration agents, Al Jazeera English reported. The Palestinian activist attributed changes in American political engagement to sustained Palestinian activism and organizing efforts.

Khalil's account centers on his personal experience within the immigration system while reflecting on broader shifts in how Palestinian issues are discussed in US politics.

title: Palestinian activist credits movement with shifting American political landscape
